# Stonehaven Capital Partners — Firm Context

- **What it is:** a mid-market private-equity firm doing **control buyouts** in the lower middle
  market. Founded in 2009 by [William Stonehaven](../people/william-stonehaven.md). Based in
  Chicago; ~40 investment and operating professionals.
- **AUM:** ~$2.5B across three funds. The active investing vehicle is
  [Fund III](../projects/fund-iii.md) (**$850M**, 2023 vintage, ~55% deployed).
- **Thesis:** acquire control equity in profitable North American companies with
  **$10M–$50M of EBITDA** and enterprise values of **$75M–$400M**, in three verticals:
  - **Healthcare services** (led by [Kate Sinclair](../profile/principal.md)),
  - **Industrials & manufacturing** (led by [Michael Brennan](../people/michael-brennan.md)),
  - **B2B software & business services** (co-led by Kate and
    [David Okonkwo](../people/david-okonkwo.md)).
- **Strategy:** **buy-and-build** — acquire a *platform* company, then compound value with
  *add-on* acquisitions and operational improvement (led by
  [Rebecca Cho](../people/rebecca-cho.md), value creation). Typical hold: 4–6 years.
- **Return targets:** underwrite to a **2.5x+ MOIC** and **~25% gross IRR** at the deal level.
- **Governance:** the **Investment Committee (IC)** approves every deal; chaired by William
  Stonehaven. Fund finance and LP reporting run through CFO
  [Laura Mendes](../people/laura-mendes.md); LP relationships through
  [Tom Restrepo](../people/tom-restrepo.md) (Investor Relations).
- **LP base:** public pensions, endowments, funds-of-funds, and family offices. Largest LP in
  Fund III is a state pension represented by [Harold Weiss](../people/harold-weiss.md).
